faq.q: What is an AI Facebook ad from a product photo?
faq.a: A square still or a tall clip made from the picture you upload. You describe the moment. An AI presenter, if one appears, is generated and is not a real customer.

faq.q: Can this lower my Facebook ad costs?
faq.a: We do not promise a lower cost-per-result. You can make another version from the same photo without paying for another shoot. Credits are charged per file, and the amount shows first.

faq.q: Are these files allowed in Facebook ads?
faq.a: Follow the current ad rules for the country where the ad will run. If Ads Manager asks you to label AI content, do that there. We do not submit the ad for you, and we do not guarantee approval.

faq.q: Do people know the ad is AI-made?
faq.a: The download does not add a disclosure for you. If the placement asks you to label AI content, do that in Ads Manager.

faq.q: What does a Facebook clip cost?
faq.a: A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and that price shows before you start. A still is 24 credits. We do not promise how soon the file is ready. If a job fails, those credits return on their own.

faq.q: Where do the headline and the price go?
faq.a: Add primary text, headline, price and the button in Ads Manager after download. The file itself does not include them.

faq.q: Does the download include sound or captions?
faq.a: No. Add sound and on-screen words after download. The file has no watermark and is yours to use.

faq.q: How should I compare two versions?
faq.a: Change one thing at a time, then use [how to test ad creatives](/guides/testing-ad-versions) as the checklist before you scale the winner.
